newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU firms bid for special 154,000 T maize exportS.
newsitem.headline: EU firms bid for special 154,000 T maize exportS.

text.p: European grain firms have bid since last Friday to export a total of 154,000 tonnes of EU maize to a target group of countries under licences carrying special refunds of 10.00 and 15.00 Ecus per tonne, EU grain industry sources said on Thursday.
But with the exception of demands placed in France, the fate of the bids was not immediately known.

The European Union has cleared bids submitted by European firms via France to export 2,645 tonnes of maize to Switzerland and Liechtenstein under licences carrying a special 10.00 Ecus refund, national grain office ONIC said.
Last Thursday the European Union set special refunds for the export of up to 75,000 tonnes of EU maize to a target group of countries.
It set a refund of 10.00 Ecus per tonne for maize exports to Switzerland and Liechtenstein and a refund of 15.00 Ecus per tonne for maize exports to Slovakia, Slovenia, the Czech Republic and Poland.
